note: FP32 on the GPU reproduces the ORT CUDA FP32 references to six decimals and the STS ranking exactly. Unified memory is reported as SHARED placement with zero DMA bytes; the live suite checks that instead of an upload on this device class. The encoder runs the whole batch as one set of dispatches per layer with a 16x16 tiled matmul; sentence pooling, L2, the NSP pooler and the classifier head are kernels, so results never leave the GPU's memory. Throughput: testdata/receipts/turbo/bench/metal-mac-embed-2026-09-22.json and metal-mac-rerank-2026-09-22.json.
